title: MySQL DuckDB Secondary Engine
description: DuckDB secondary engine plugin: query offload, binlog applier, copies, history, executor. Status counters from PMM's mysqld_exporter; applier lag, copies and progress from the custom queries in queries-duckdb-medium.yml (copies, stages, last refusal code).

panels.title: Plugin
panels.description: duckdb_enable: OFF means the server behaves as if the plugin were not loaded.

panels.title: Applier state
panels.description: duckdb_apply_reader_state_code: idle (everything applied), reading, waiting to commit, committing, refreshing (a copy after DDL), error (the applier stopped: see the error log), stopped.

panels.title: Lag
panels.description: duckdb_apply_lag_seconds: age of the oldest transaction committed in MySQL and not yet in DuckDB (0 when everything is applied), as Seconds_Behind_Source.

panels.title: Lag (binlog bytes)
panels.description: duckdb_apply_lag_bytes: binary log between the applied position and the end of the binary log, across files.

panels.title: Avg offloaded query
panels.description: Average time in DuckDB of the queries it ran, over the time range (duckdb_offload_time_us / duckdb_offload_queries).

panels.title: Offload ratio
panels.description: Queries run in DuckDB / queries tried in DuckDB, over the time range. Refused queries ran on InnoDB (or failed with FORCED).

panels.title: DDL failures (range)
panels.description: Copies the applier could not follow after a DDL: they are STALE now (see the table below).

panels.title: Copies by state
panels.description: DuckDB copies (INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DUCKDB_TABLES): LOADED, REFRESHING, REFRESH_PENDING, STALE.

panels.title: History copies
panels.description: Copies with retain_history: their archived rows exist only in the lake.

panels.title: Stale copies
panels.description: Copies no longer applied (DROP / detach of a history table, or a failed refresh). Reattach, SECONDARY_UNLOAD or duckdb_discard_stale_copy.

panels.title: Last refusal
panels.description: duckdb_offload_last_refusal: why the last query did not run in DuckDB.

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: duckdb_offload_queries (run to the end), duckdb_offload_refused, duckdb_offload_explained.

panels.title: Offload ratio
panels.description: Share of the queries tried in DuckDB that ran there.

panels.title: Average offloaded query time
panels.description: duckdb_offload_time_us / duckdb_offload_queries: time in DuckDB (execution and fetch, plus a first run during optimization) per query run there.

panels.title: Read your own writes
panels.description: Queries that waited for the session's last commit (duckdb_offload_wait_applied) and those that hit duckdb_offload_wait_timeout_ms. Timeouts growing: the applier is behind.

panels.title: FULL scope guard
panels.description: duckdb_guard: statements on history tables under FULL scope.

panels.title: DECIMAL reruns
panels.description: Runs again with fewer decimals (duckdb_decimal_overflow=ROUND).

panels.title: Read from the binary log
panels.description: Transactions and row events read (all tables).

panels.title: Rows
panels.description: Rows of loaded tables decoded, changes after collapsing per primary key, rows written to DuckDB.

panels.title: Batches
panels.description: One DuckLake commit per batch; large transactions are applied in pieces (duckdb_apply_batch_max_rows).

panels.title: Applier lag (seconds)
panels.description: duckdb_apply_lag_seconds: age of the oldest transaction committed in MySQL and not yet in DuckDB (0 when caught up).

panels.title: Applier lag (binlog bytes)
panels.description: duckdb_apply_lag_bytes: binary log not yet applied, across files (it does not drop when a file rotates).

panels.title: History
panels.description: Deletes in transactions tagged duckdb_avoid_purge become archived rows in DuckDB.

panels.title: DDL handled by the applier
panels.description: Refreshes after DDL, RENAMEs followed, refreshes deferred to a later rename, failures (copy marked STALE).

panels.title: DuckDB copies
panels.description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DUCKDB_TABLES (custom query).

panels.title: Refresh / load progress
panels.description: Copies being refreshed after DDL (DUCKDB_TABLES) and loads or waits in progress (Performance Schema stages stage/duckdb/%, README.md). Rows done / InnoDB's estimate.

panels.title: DuckDB memory
panels.description: duckdb_memory_used_bytes (duckdb_memory(), sampled about every 5 s) against duckdb_memory_limit.

panels.title: Spill to disk
panels.description: duckdb_temp_spill_bytes: data DuckDB moved to its temporary directory (tmp/ in the lake) because of the memory limit.

panels.title: Executor threads
panels.description: Busy executor threads against duckdb_executor_threads, and tasks waiting. A queue that stays above 0: raise duckdb_executor_threads.

panels.title: Executor tasks
panels.description: DuckDB calls run by the executor.

panels.title: Query slots
panels.description: Offloaded queries holding a slot against duckdb_max_concurrent_queries (0 means the default, max(2, cores / 4)).

panels.title: Query slot waits
panels.description: Queries that waited for a slot. Many waits with little spill: raise duckdb_max_concurrent_queries; spill with waits: keep it or lower it.

panels.title: Memory limit
panels.description: duckdb_memory_limit (global value).

panels.title: DuckDB threads
panels.description: duckdb_threads (global value).

panels.title: Executor threads
panels.description: duckdb_executor_threads (global value).

panels.title: Max concurrent queries
panels.description: duckdb_max_concurrent_queries (global value).

panels.title: Batch max trx
panels.description: duckdb_apply_batch_max_trx (global value).

panels.title: Batch max rows
panels.description: duckdb_apply_batch_max_rows (global value).

panels.title: Batch max delay
panels.description: duckdb_apply_batch_max_delay_ms (global value).

panels.title: Offload min rows
panels.description: duckdb_offload_min_rows (global value).

panels.title: Wait timeout
panels.description: duckdb_offload_wait_timeout_ms (global value).
